```{r}
#Load the packages required
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

**Exercise - Reading UK public health monitoring data**
The public health website is not accessible to me. Therefore, the rhinovirus data is used in the following exercise.
```{r}
rhinovirus<-read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
gt(head(rhinovirus))
```

**Exercise - Plotting public health data**
```{r}
ggplot(rhinovirus,aes(
  x=date,
  y=metric_value
))+
  geom_line(colour="blue")+
  xlab("Specimen Week")+
  ylab("Weekly possibility (%)")+
  ggtitle("Weekly posibility of people receiving postive result from a PCR test")
```
